description: Opera web browser with portable profile persistence and reduced promotional UI
post_install: if ($target) { $folder = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('StartMenu')) 'Programs\Scoop Apps'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $folder | Out-Null; $link = (New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell).CreateShortcut((Join-Path $folder 'Opera.lnk')); $link.TargetPath = $target.FullName; $link.Arguments = '--user-data-dir="' + (Join-Path $persist_dir 'profile') + '" --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check'; $link.WorkingDirectory = $target.DirectoryName; $link.IconLocation = $target.FullName + ',0'; $link.Save() }

script: foreach ($path_segment in $path_segments.TrimEnd('/')) { $release_url = 'https://get.geo.opera.com/pub/opera/desktop/{0}/win/' -f $path_segment; $download_page = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $release_url -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; $installer_name = $download_page.Links | Where-Object { $_.href -match '(?<=Setup\w+)\.exe$' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty href -First 1; if ($null -ne $installer_name) { Write-Output $installer_name; break } }
